cards.text: Abraham packs up and moves south into the Negev, settling between Kadesh and Shur. While he's staying in a town called Gerar, he says something about Sarah, his wife. Friend, brace yourself.

cards.question: While he's staying in Gerar, what does Abraham say about his wife Sarah?

cards.text: He tried this same move once before, down in Egypt (Genesis 12:11-13). SAME MOVE. Different zip code. Now meet Abimelech, king of Gerar.

cards.question: Once Abraham calls Sarah his sister, what does Abimelech king of Gerar do?

cards.text: One night God comes to Abimelech in a dream and tells him he's as good as dead because of the woman he's taken. I used to wake up to dust falling on my face in that drawer, and I'd STILL take that over this.

cards.question: God tells Abimelech he's as good as dead because Sarah is a ___ woman.

cards.text: Abimelech is about to answer God. But first, the text slips in a detail about him and Sarah.

cards.question: By the time of the dream, Abimelech had already gone near Sarah.

cards.text: Then Abimelech answers: "Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?" The man is in the MIDDLE of a dream and he goes straight into courtroom mode.

cards.question: Abimelech says Abraham told him Sarah was his sister. Who else does Abimelech say backed up that story?

cards.text: Abimelech says he did this with integrity in his heart and innocence in his hands. Then God answers him, still in the dream.

cards.question: God tells Abimelech He knows Abimelech did this with a clear conscience.
According to God, why didn't Abimelech touch Sarah?

cards.text: Now God gives Abimelech his orders: give the man's wife back. And God tells Abimelech something about Abraham.

cards.question: God says Abraham is a ___ and he will ___ for Abimelech so Abimelech will live.
God warns that if Abimelech doesn't give Sarah back, only Abimelech himself will die.

cards.text: Early the next morning Abimelech gets up, calls in all his servants and tells them everything that happened. Picture that staff meeting. First item on the agenda: the boss had a dream.

cards.question: When Abimelech tells his servants everything that happened, the men are ___.

cards.text: Then Abimelech calls Abraham in and asks, "What have you done to us?" I bet Abraham feels like somebody called into the boss's office at 4:59 on a Friday.

cards.question: Abimelech says Abraham has brought tremendous ___ on him and his kingdom.

cards.text: He tells Abraham he's done things that should not be done, then asks what prompted him to do such a thing. Not what happened, friend. WHAT PROMPTED YOU.

cards.question: Abraham says he thought to himself that there was no ___ of God in Gerar.
What was Abraham afraid the people of Gerar would do?

answers.text: Kill him because of his wife
Drive him out of the land

cards.text: Then Abraham adds a "besides": he says Sarah really is his sister. That's a LOT of weight to put on one little "besides."

cards.question: Abraham says Sarah is the daughter of his mother, but not the daughter of his father.

cards.text: Then Abraham takes it all the way back to when God had him journey from his father's house. He says that's when he asked Sarah to show her loyalty to him.

cards.question: Abraham asked Sarah to say this of him wherever they went: He is my ___.

cards.text: So Abimelech gives Sarah back to Abraham. And she's not the only thing he hands over.

cards.question: Along with Sarah, Abimelech gives Abraham sheep, cattle, menservants and maidservants.

cards.text: Called in for a talking-to, walks out with a HERD. Then Abimelech has something to say about his land.

cards.question: What does Abimelech tell Abraham about his land?

cards.text: Then Abimelech tells Sarah he's giving "your brother" a thousand pieces of silver. Your brother, friend. He's STILL saying it.

cards.question: What does Abimelech tell Sarah the thousand pieces of silver mean for her?

cards.text: Then Abraham prays to God, and God heals Abimelech, his wife and his maidservants. Why did they need healing? The very last verse finally tells us.

cards.question: On account of Sarah, what had the LORD done in Abimelech's household?
After God heals them, Abimelech's wife and maidservants can bear children again.

cards.text: But we're not sealing Abraham's box yet, friend. His story keeps going, and I'm keeping the oven warm for it.

findings.problem: The card calls Gerar "a town called Gerar." The text never calls Gerar a town. It has a king, and Abimelech calls it "my kingdom" (20:9) and speaks of "a nation" (20:4).
